PLAN THE WORK

Think about the whole system.

Adding a room, changing a layout or renovating a bathroom can change what you need from the heating. The position and size of radiators, the controls and the existing pipework should be considered together.

Tell Connor which rooms are affected and what you want to improve. A heating upgrade can be discussed alongside a boiler replacement or as a separate project.
